scope: Exploratory automatic-mask matched native SAM2.1 on previously inspected seq11, seq20 and seq23; not historical ground-truth-prompt results or independent validation.
source: Clean external/sam2_diagnostic_reference checkout, matching pinned official revision; no author source edits.
prompt: Exact frozen automatic mask, original prompt frame and sequence 23 fixed viewport shared with the same-device SAMURAI and project Lean comparisons. Start predictor locally at frame zero after rebasing; pre-prompt frames are saved as empty. No detector or labels at inference.
device: MPS FP32, deterministic algorithms, seed 20261021, MPS fallback and fast math disabled. The scoped blocking pointer-position transfer is applied to avoid an observed MPS temporary-buffer race; CPU uses author source unmodified.
engineering: Two fresh MPS runs and one CPU run on at least ten post-prompt frames with identical prompt/source/state; require repeat mask disagreement no more than 0.01% of frame pixels and report CPU/MPS differences. This numerical tolerance is an engineering check, not an inference threshold. Full output must be frozen before labels are opened.
limitations: A short gate is not full-video reliability, patient independence is unknown, and native architecture/budgets differ from Lean and SAMURAI.
